name: CoRA_math_reasoning_benchmark
description: A benchmark of mathematical problem-solving that targets multi-step reasoning across varied math topics. It measures a model's ability to produce correct final answers (and often intermediate reasoning) for challenging math questions.
evaluation_method: accuracy (exact match/equivalence of final numeric or symbolic answer, sometimes with programmatic verification)
reputation: A targeted math-reasoning benchmark gaining attention among researchers studying chain-of-thought and symbolic problem solving.
